DF 295908.asmo: Ambasciatori Ungheria b. 2, Beltrame Costabili (1491) no. 6
DF 295908.evidence: Recto (MNL image 0001, viewed at full size in crops): every cipher group carries a contemporary interlinear gloss: 'il governo del arcivescovato di Strigonio', 'la Regina', 'sua M.ta', 'pocha opinione', 'del arcivescovo', 'Sciupiana(?) et lo arcivescovo', 'in peregrinio(?)', 'famiglia del arcivescovo', 'ne compagni(?)'. Verso (0002) is clear text, subscription and address. No ungapped cipher seen. Vestigia: no notes, no sub-record (295908-a/-b do not exist); Kuffart 2018 pp. 105, 204 cited (not opened). Not in Berzeviczy 1914 (no 1491 Costabili item in its list).

DF 295909.evidence: The letter itself is clear Italian (images 0003-0005, 0001 address). The cipher is a separate slip (numbered 8) attached across the recto, 9 lines beginning in clear 'De le cosse' then cipher. A second slip (numbered 7) lies over it in the photographs: a contemporary clear decipherment of the whole slip, 'De le cose de la Regina non mi posso significare altro a V. Ex.tia senon che sua M.ta sta expectante la ritornata del Re de Hungaria ... de qualche cosa' (image 0002; image 0003 shows the cipher slip with the decipherment folded back). Vestigia: no notes, no sub-record, no publication.

DF 295914-a.evidence: The entry's DF list omitted this letter; Vestigia files it as DF 295914-a, no. 12a. Recto (0001): about 25 lines mostly in cipher with clear words; verso (0002) clear (ending 'Strig. xv Junij 1491'); 0003 address. Filed with it, and linked to it in Vestigia (related document), is no. 12b = DF 295914 (Vestigia 4058, 'egyszerű másolat', 1 p., incipit 'Le cosse della Regina che anchora stanno come stavano', explicit 'vogli mandare qualche odori'): a contemporary clear copy of the whole ciphered recto, with marginal glosses; its text follows the recto's clear words line for line ('ma de altri non. Et per facendo instantia ...', 'per la via de Milano', 'Ancora prega V. Ex. gli vogli mandar qualche odori'). Not in Berzeviczy 1914.

DF 295935.evidence: Partial interlinear decipherment. Four pages (0001-0004); cipher passages on 0001, 0002 and 0004, 0003 clear. Most cipher lines carry a contemporary gloss above them ('traducta a Buda cum quello honore', 'conveniva a sua M.ta', 'li termini sono passati', 'il S. Re', 'conclusione', 'de Alba Regale', 'li Principali Baroni non gerano presenti', 'della Regina sua mando lo ambassatore Regio patreno e me a Buda', 'a proposito de Monsignore figliolo suo', 'a tuti li Sig. Prelati e Baroni e comissioni', 'ala traductione', 'il titulo et nome', 'dal consiglio loro', 'la Regina pochi de epsi non sono amici' ...). Seen in full-size crops without a gloss: on 0001 the lines '-odyb, p- 8o + 4qπ...' and 'Jt-ra o-a 4tdzya o-a qbsoπayai'; on 0004 the lines 'q- uo ya ttyb qro ctdro qbdayb' and 'qcπz yby cd-oπg8q tadga'. About four lines of cipher are unglossed; they are in the same simple sign substitution and can be read with the key that the glosses on this leaf give. No clear copy filed (no sub-record), no notes, no publication.

DF 295963.evidence: The letter is almost wholly cipher (0001 recto viewed: about 30 lines of signs with a few clear words, opening in clear 'per una altra mia in zifara de XV del presente'). Filed with it is no. 44b = DF 295963-a (Vestigia 4065, 'egyszerű másolat', 2 leaves, 4 images), linked as a related document: a contemporary clear copy with the same incipit and the same explicit ('... come passano le cose et del tuto sii advisata'), headed 'Strigonia 1491 ... 30 Xbre Beltrame Cost.'. Image 1 of 44b viewed: continuous clear Italian; the leaf is holed in a few places (a few words lost in the copy, not checked against the cipher). Not in Berzeviczy 1914.

DF 295974.evidence: Printed in clear by Berzeviczy, Aragoniai Beatrix magyar királyné életére vonatkozó okiratok (MHH Diplomataria 39, 1914) no. CLV, pp. 216-219, headed 'Titkos írásjegyekkel írva' (written in secret characters); the OCR text (archive.org aragoniaibeatrix00berz) matches Vestigia's incipit and explicit and carries the post datum 'Mons.re suo prefato figliolo non fu a la dieta'. Also Berzeviczy 1908 pp. 518-520 (Vestigia; not opened). Decipherments are filed too: image 1 of the original (ASMo photo set, the only images Vestigia serves for this record) carries interlinear glosses over the cipher ('le cosse de la Regina', 'ala futura dieta', 'la dieta fu facta a questi di', 'conclusione', 'de hungaria', 'desperarsene totalmente', 'a Buda' ...); and no. 8c = DF 295974-3 (Vestigia 4067, 4 pp.) is a contemporary clear copy headed 'Exemplum litterarum R.di d.ni Beltrandi ad Ill.mam d. Duchissam Ferr.', covering the 20 March letter and the 23 March enclosure (no. 8b, DF 295974-2, Vestigia 4066/6543). Images 2-9 of the original and 2-4 of 8c not viewed.

recommendation.text: Close. All six distinct despatches have a contemporary decipherment filed on or with them (four interlinear: 295908 complete, 295935 partial, 295974; two clear copies: 12b for 295914-a, 44b for 295963; one decipherment slip for 295909), and 295974 is printed in clear in Berzeviczy 1914 no. CLV. The only cipher with no decipherment seen is about four lines of DF 295935, readable from the same leaf's glosses: a key-application job, not an open cipher. No change to catalogue.json is needed, because the entry already left the catalogue on 2 Nov 2026 (id 361, verdict partly_read). The one fix owed is to the b14 vetting: lead 1900's 'catalogue 361 should read catalogue 348' correction should be reversed, and the removed record's 'partly_read' could be updated to say that every despatch has a filed decipherment (295935 partly) and that R1165 is DF 295914-a with clear copy 12b.
